description: Prevent canonical execution of an already committed Disengage action from attempting to spend the same Full Action a second time.
planning_goal: Use the certified Disengage corridor/context and action-economy architecture to fix the false failure after valid committed-plan execution. Frame Conn Turn state is authoritative for planning-time action expenditure: full.disengage is already present in the current turn's unexecuted usedActions entry before its effect executes. When canonical execution begins for such an entry, build its ExecutionContext with the existing ignoreActionCost flag so global action-economy hooks do not validate or commit the Full Action a second time. Preserve normal action-economy validation for canonical executions that are not backed by a matching unexecuted committed Turn entry. Preserve Disengage status/suppression semantics and genuine execution failures.
acceptance_criteria: full.disengage executed from an unexecuted committed Turn entry uses the existing ExecutionContext ignoreActionCost flag.
The committed Full Action remains spent exactly once by authoritative Turn state.
Disengage status/suppression execution still runs through the existing canonical transaction and status-orchestration path.
A successful committed Disengage produces a succeeded canonical transaction instead of a false partial/failed result caused by duplicate action-economy spending.
Canonical executions without a matching unexecuted committed Turn entry retain normal action-economy validation and commit behavior.
No native Lancer behavior, Disengage rules semantics, targeting, or unrelated action execution is changed.
non_goals: Change Disengage duration or suppression semantics.
